meta.change_1_1: 16 Nov late (parent, after council review): a full 360-degree swivel circle and keeping the cat posts in this room were hard rules that invalidated 8 of 9 designer layouts; now a 45-degree partial turn is hard, the full circle is a preference, and cat posts may move to another room if listed.

plain_policy: Arrange the seating the household already owns around a coffee table so people can talk, with a good seat for the TV, and keep storage and the cats' posts. No beds. All three ways into the room are at its west end (dining arch, hall opening, entry arch), so the west end is the walkway and the seating belongs east of it. Nothing may collide or stand on the hearth; the walks between the three openings must stay at least 24 inches; a coffee table needs at least 12 inches from every seat it serves. Everything else is a trade-off measured against today. Priorities in order: the walks between the openings, a conversation group within about 8 feet, a comfortable TV seat, storage, fewest new pieces, cost.
